title: NormalizedDetectionBox
description: YOLO-style axis-aligned box in normalized image coordinates. Shared by case_bundle, dataset patient chunks, and APFusion delta ops.

cls.description: Class id; bone metastasis projects typically use 0.

conf.description: Detector confidence; GT boxes may use 1.0.

lesion_id.description: Stable id within a case after pairing; optional on raw pred.

bone_label.description: Optional human-readable anatomy after bone matching.

bone_label_id.description: Optional numeric label from bone mask (Big/Axis merged semantics).
